76138-odd-made-even.title: Stories
76138-odd-made-even.creator: Unknown
76138-odd-made-even.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Molly was always a fair sight to look upon—a sweet, fresh English maiden, with a sunny golden head and irreproachable features, and soft red lips that looked as if only smiles could come from them. Molly was blest with a happy, sunshiny disposition. She took life easily, and her cares and sorrows at present were bound up in the life of the heroine of her imagination. She was young enough and gay enough to like to revel in imaginary misery.

arxiv-1701-08665.title: Redefinition of the concept of fuzzy set based on vague partition from the perspective of axiomatization Journal: ArXiv
arxiv-1701-08665.creator: Xiaodong Pan, Yang Xu
arxiv-1701-08665.description: Abstract Based on the in-depth analysis of the essence and features of vague phenomena, this paper focuses on establishing the axiomatical foundation of membership degree theory for vague phenomena, presents an axiomatic system to govern membership degrees and their interconnections.

arxiv-2212-08768.title: Electronic Density of States of a U ⁡ ( 1 ) U\left(1\right) Quantum Spin Liquid with Spinon Fermi Surface. II. Zeeman Magnetic Field Effects
arxiv-2212-08768.creator: Wen-Yu He, Patrick A. Lee
arxiv-2212-08768.description: Abstract The Zeeman effect lowers the energy of electrons with spin states which are anti-parallel to the applied magnetic field but lifts that of spin parallel states. In quantum spin liquids where the spin and charge degrees of freedom are fractionalized, anomalous Zeeman response may be expected.

arxiv-2407-13867.title: Poincare gauge gravity from nonmetric gravity
arxiv-2407-13867.creator: James T. Wheeler †
arxiv-2407-13867.description: Abstract We consider general linear gauge theory, with independent solder form and connection. These spaces have both torsion and nonmetricity. We show that the Cartan structure equations together with the defining equation for nonmetricity allow the mixed symmetry components of nonmetricity to be absorbed into an altered torsion tensor.

arxiv-2409-18370.title: Discovery and inversion of the viscoelastic wave equation in inhomogeneous media
arxiv-2409-18370.creator: Su Chen, Yi Ding, Hiroe Miyake, Xiaojun Li
arxiv-2409-18370.description: Abstract In scientific machine learning, the task of identifying partial differential equations accurately from sparse and noisy data poses a significant challenge. Current sparse regression methods may identify inaccurate equations on sparse and noisy datasets and are not suitable for varying coefficients.

arxiv-2506-13221.title: Conditional a priori error estimates of finite volume and Runge-Kutta discontinuous Galerkin methods with abstract limiting for hyperbolic systems of conservation laws in 1D
arxiv-2506-13221.creator: Fabio Leotta
arxiv-2506-13221.description: Abstract . We derive conditional a priori error estimates of a wide class of finite volume and Runge-Kutta discontinuous Galerkin methods with abstract limiting for hyperbolic systems of conservation laws in 1D via the verification of weak consistency and entropy stability, as recently proposed by Bressan et al. [ 4 ] .

arxiv-2511-11326.title: Arity hierarchies for quantifiers closed under partial polymorphisms
arxiv-2511-11326.creator: Anuj Dawar, Lauri Hella, Benedikt Pago
arxiv-2511-11326.description: Abstract We investigate the expressive power of generalized quantifiers closed under partial polymorphism conditions motivated by the study of constraint satisfaction problems. We answer a number of questions arising from the work of Dawar and Hella (CSL 2024) where such quantifiers were introduced.

pmc-10648581.title: MicroRNA Landscape in Endometrial Carcinomas in an Asian population: Unraveling Subtype-Specific Signatures
pmc-10648581.creator: Gideon Ze Lin Tan, Sai Mun Leong, Yu Jin, Chik Hong Kuick, Jeremy Joon Keat Chee, San Zeng Low, Ling-Wen Ding, He Cheng, Diana Lim, Susan Swee-Shan Hue, David Wong
pmc-10648581.description: Simple SummaryIn this paper, we analyzed the expression of microRNAs in endometrial carcinomas, measuring their expression in histological subtypes, molecular subtypes, and tumors with CTNNB1 mutations. Our findings provide an insight into different microRNA expression profiles in the different subtypes of endometrial carcinoma in an Asian population and may have implications for the diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis of endometrial carcinoma.

pmc-10833642.creator: Kamran Abbasi, Parveen Ali, Virginia Barbour, Thomas Benfield, Kirsten Bibbins-Domingo, Stephen Hancocks, Richard Horton, Laurie Laybourn-Langton, Robert Mash, Peush Sahni, Wadeia Mohammad Sharief, Paul Yonga, Chris Zielinski

This overall environmental crisis is now so severe as to be a global health emergency. The world is currently responding to the climate crisis and the nature crisis as if they were separate challenges. This is a dangerous mistake.

pmc-11414635.title: The Association Between Triglyceride Glucose-Body Mass Index and Kidney Impairment in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-11414635.creator: Nan Huang, Bing Lu, Zhuan-Zhuan Zhu, Xiang-Yun Zhu, Sheng Chen, Zhi-Yi Shu, Gai-Fang Liu, You-Fan Peng, Ling Li
pmc-11414635.description: PurposeInsulin resistance is associated with kidney impairment in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). The triglyceride glucose-body mass index (TyG-BMI), which combines the TyG index with body mass index (BMI), has received significant attention as a tool for evaluating insulin resistance.

pmc-12432522.title: ﻿Additions to woody litter fungi of Byssosphaeria, Phaeoseptum and Pseudothyridariella (Pleosporales, Ascomycota) from China
pmc-12432522.creator: Wen-Xin Su, Ranagul Tieliwadi, Wen-Ying Su, Xiao Li, Rong Xu
pmc-12432522.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ﻿AbstractPleosporales, the largest order within Ascomycota, is globally distributed and exhibits remarkable host diversity. Fagaceae, a plant family of significant ecological importance in the Northern Hemisphere, harbors a wide array of fungal species. During an investigation of pleosporalean fungi associated with woody litter from Fagaceae plants, dead wood samples with fungal fruiting bodies were collected in Henan and Jiangxi provinces, China.

pmc-12581549.title: Effectiveness of 3D-Slicer simulated neuro-navigation assisted minimally invasive neuro-endoscopic surgery for basal ganglia hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage
pmc-12581549.creator: Jiachen Cai, Yukun Hu, Guangliang Zeng, Zhenhua Shi, Junxiang Wang, Yitao Miao, Qi Shao, Yun Qiu, Xin Jin, Mingjie Gong, Hongqiang Zhang, Jie Wang, Tingwang Jiang, Guoping Shao, Chengfa Sun
pmc-12581549.description: ObjectiveThe study aimed to compare the effectiveness of endoscopic surgery assisted by 3D-Slicer with traditional craniotomy for treating basal ganglia hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage (HICH).MethodsA total of 133 individuals diagnosed with hypertensive intracerebral hemorrhage in the basal ganglia region underwent surgical intervention in the Department of Neurosurgery at Affiliated Changshu Hospital of Nantong University from January 2018 to June 2023.

pmc-12605100.title: Identification of the immune subtypes associated with the prognosis and immunotherapy of metastatic melanoma
pmc-12605100.creator: Feng Zhang, Xiaodong Zhang, Huanzhong Su, Longcheng Hong, Yuhui Wu, Chang Shu
pmc-12605100.description: BackgroundMelanoma is an aggressive malignant tumor, characterized by high mortality. A growing amount of research indicates that the tumor immune microenvironment is closely associated with the survival outcomes and immunotherapy benefit for patients with advanced tumors. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying the effect of the tumor immune microenvironment on metastatic melanoma have not been clarified in detail.

pmc-13071056.title: Targeting glial scar formation for spinal cord injury: mechanisms, strategies, and research progress review
pmc-13071056.creator: Chaochao Zhang, Jiaxiao Shi
pmc-13071056.description: Spinal cord injury is often followed by the formation of a glial scar which acts as a major barrier for axonal regrowth and recovery after spinal injuries. The glial scar consists of a complex mixture of cells and extracellular molecules that have different effects; they protect injured areas from further damage but at the same time inhibit axonal sprouting.

pmc-13165573.title: Impact of Multilayer Coatings on the Mechanical and Durability Performance of FRCM Composites
pmc-13165573.creator: Ali Çopuroğlu, Bekir Yilmaz Pekmezci
pmc-13165573.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fabric-reinforced cementitious matrix (FRCM) composites are strengthening systems composed of a technical textile embedded in a cementitious or lime-based matrix and are increasingly used for strengthening existing masonry and concrete structures due to their compatibility with traditional substrates. The mechanical behavior of FRCM composites is controlled by the combined contribution of the textile reinforcement, the matrix, and the interface developed between them, with the textile–matrix interface playing a critical role in stress transfer, crack development, and post-cracking response.

pmc-13498462.title: VPS37A loss creates CASP8-dependent vulnerability via the MAP3K7–NF-κB–CFLAR axis
pmc-13498462.creator: Tatsuya Hattori, Longgui Chen, Xinwen Liang, Kouta Hamamoto, Hong-Gang Wang, Yoshinori Takahashi
pmc-13498462.description: VPS37A, a subunit of ESCRT-I involved in endosomal sorting and autophagy, is frequently downregulated in diverse human cancers. In this study, we showed that VPS37A downregulation, as part of a large chromosome 8p deletion, arises early during tumorigenesis and persists throughout tumor progression.
